title: A design scenario where final materially affects Java code
answer: AeroTopo uses final to encode design intent at several levels. `Product.id` and product-specific resolution fields are assigned once, concrete product classes are final to close their inheritance hierarchy, and `Product.id()` is final so identity behavior cannot be redefined by subclasses. These restrictions make invariants easier to reason about, but final should be used where stability is intentional rather than applied everywhere by default.
